chapter: Harlem youth, Monk and Bird, and Greensboro
title: Elmo Hope
summary: McLean met Elmo at Bud's house at 15 or 16; Elmo was Bud's peer and played classical recitals with him.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: What about Elmo Hope? Was he playing?
Elmo I met at Bud’s house when I was 15, 16. So I had a relationship with him.
That went in later to recording and so forth.
Was he up under Bud, the same way that you were?

No, because they were both peers. In fact I understand that Bud got a lot of stuff from Elmo. Elmo was the first to play a lot of things that Bud gets credit for. And they used to play classical together at Carnegie Hall, recitals and stuff like that. So they were very close as young guys together.
